structural_breaks.note: FY2018 annual report 释义 adds 变压器 (power transformers) to 线圈类产品 (2016-2018H1 definition: 中性点接地产品、电抗器、互感器). Prior-year FY2017 figure (820.79) was NOT recast, so the company treats the series as continuous; the transformer contribution before FY2018 is unknown. FY2018H2 (= FY2018 new-definition total − FY2018H1 old-definition value) and FY2019H1 YoY therefore straddle the definition change.

FY2019 annual report renames to 线圈类及相关产品 and adds 油色谱及在线监测系统 (DGA online monitoring, previously in 智能设备类); FY2018 comparative (965.61) not recast. The 2019 H1 report (释义 p.4) still classed 油色谱及在线监测系统 under 智能设备类, so FY2019H2 (= FY2019 1,370.96 new definition − FY2019H1 543.31 old definition) absorbs the FULL-YEAR DGA revenue, and the 2020 H1 report compares 643.38 (new) with an un-recast 543.31 (old) — verified 2026-09-25 from the 2019 H1 report p.4/p.12, FY2019 AR p.4/p.14 and 2020 H1 report p.4/p.12.

2025 product structure: 开关类/变压器类/保护及自动化类/电力电子类/EPC类/储能系统及元件类/租赁. FY2024 annual report printed only an industry split (no product split) so FY2024H2 is missing; 2025 AR recasts FY2024 变压器类业务 = 3,348.38 and the 2026 H1 report recasts 2025H1 = 2,010.10. Values from FY2025H1 on are 变压器类业务 and are not strictly comparable with 线圈类及相关产品 (FY2024H1 1,673.91).
